question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin, an official external ClawHub provider, or remain documented as a custom-provider configuration?
rationale: The current provider SDK can support LongCat, but repository policy keeps core lean and makes optional bundled providers a maintainer product and ownership decision.

options.title: Official external provider first
options.body: Build LongCat as an OpenClaw-maintained external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, with a later bundled promotion only if maintainers accept the core-package cost.

options.title: Bundle in core now
options.body: Add LongCat under extensions with native onboarding and catalog support, accepting the ongoing bundled-provider maintenance and release surface.

options.title: Keep custom-provider docs only
options.body: Do not add an official plugin yet, and rely on LongCat's documented custom models.providers workaround until demand or ownership is clearer.

recommendation.title: Official external provider first
recommendation.body: Build LongCat as an OpenClaw-maintained external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, with a later bundled promotion only if maintainers accept the core-package cost.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current maintainer issue and has recent merged provider-area history.
